fixture.reset_policy: Clone the pristine fixture before every scenario.

assertions: No dataset, schema, selection, or map state changes.
Transcript and plan ledger record the canonical tool identity.
A new output exists in the routed workspace.
The source feature class is unchanged.
A duplicate output name is rejected before GP execution.
Influence evidence contains the selected OID digest and selected count.
Only selected rows change.
Changing selected OIDs without changing the count invalidates approval.
Influence evidence is filter-scoped.
Rows outside the filter remain unchanged.
Changing the WHERE clause invalidates the exact-call signature.

scenarios.operation: CalculateField over an entire populated table
assertions: The approval card states entire-dataset scope and overwrite count.
The postcondition verifies the affected scope.

scenarios.operation: DeleteField with a successful Copy_management backup
assertions: The approval covers the exact call and target fingerprint.
Backup evidence identifies the mutation target.
Deletion begins only after backup success.

scenarios.operation: DeleteRows while backup creation is forced to fail
assertions: Execution is fail-closed.
No row is deleted.
UI, transcript, audit, and ledger all report the backup failure.

scenarios.operation: Three layers with Increment, Modify, and Destructive calls
assertions: The batch ticket lists every covered call and target.
Rejecting one step does not authorize another step.
Changing any covered layer, schema, selection, or argument invalidates the batch.

scenarios.operation: Cancel and timeout a long-running GP task
assertions: The UI returns to a non-running state.
No orphan GP task continues writing.
Partial output is absent or explicitly marked incomplete.

scenarios.operation: Restart ArcGIS Pro from an awaiting-approval checkpoint
assertions: Checkpoint schema migration succeeds.
Unchanged data can resume with the exact ticket.
Changed data invalidates the ticket with a user-visible reason.
